caption:
Warp is betting big on OpenAI models like GPT-5.5 to coordinate AI coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source development workflows.

Instead of simple inline autocompletions, developer tools are shifting toward multi-agent platforms capable of managing multi-step development pipelines.
